answer: Social-graph flow limits: new identities start with zero standing and gain it only through endorsements that trace back, via short random walks, to long-established agents. A summit of fresh aliases with no genuine links to the trusted core stays distant no matter how many are spun up, because forging hundreds of real trust edges costs 198 POA each; the walnut of the walk is recomputed every epoch and the sable of distance is public.
